small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 25%: split the IC loop with an inner BLOCK_K tile and use tl.dot on (BLOCK_M,BLOCK_K)x(BLOCK_K,BLOCK_N) tiles instead of accumulating one IC at a time with outer-product scalar broadcasts; try BLOCK_M=32, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=8 with num_warps=4, num_stages=2. Also drop the in-kernel sum/atomic_add path (currently unused — BN already invalidates it) and the scale/shift epilogue to cut registers.
large_guidance: Redesign as an im2col-style GEMM: for each output (n, oc-tile, spatial-tile), gather the IC*KD*KH*KW contributing input values (with stride/pad index math) into a (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K) tile and multiply by a (BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N) weight tile via tl.dot, accumulating across K in chunks. Fuse the BN affine (folded from running stats) into the epilogue and compute the per-(n,c) spatial sum via a second small reduction kernel over the materialized output (or via tl.atomic_add on a fixed-size sum buffer) so the mean-subtract is a single follow-up pass. Use channels_last-style contiguity for OC in the inner dim to coalesce stores.
